title: 同伴评审
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/04_APB - Peer Reviews.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/04_APB - Peer Reviews/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着两份论文初稿，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank paper drafts and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲怎样给同学的论文做互评。

shots.scene: 放大镜、红笔、加号、问号四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a magnifying glass, a red pen, a plus sign and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 读得细、评得准、说得暖、问得清。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿到小研的初稿，只写了“不错”两个字就还回去
shots.prompt_en: The young male student receives a blank draft from the female graduate student, scribbles one short mark on it and hands it straight back.
shots.narration: 阿杰评小研的论文，只写了一个“好”。

shots.scene: 小研拿着稿子，有点失望
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the returned draft and looks a little disappointed.
shots.narration: 小研不知道哪里该改，白评了一场。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 好的互评，要有方法。

shots.scene: 两个同学隔桌交换论文
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student swap blank drafts across a desk.
shots.narration: 同伴互评，就是审阅同学的作品，

shots.scene: 一份初稿变成一份更整齐的论文，中间有箭头
shots.prompt_en: A messy blank draft with an arrow pointing to a neater, polished paper. No people.
shots.narration: 提出建议，让内容、结构和行文更好。

shots.scene: 阿杰先翻开空白的评分表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student first opens a blank grading rubric sheet on the desk.
shots.narration: 第一步，先看评分表，知道标准。

shots.scene: 阿杰通读初稿，在页边贴小便签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank draft and sticks small sticky notes in the margins.
shots.narration: 通读一遍，把需要注意的地方记下来。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照评分表，第二遍写反馈
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rereads the draft with the rubric beside it and writes feedback.
shots.narration: 再读一遍，对照评分表写反馈。

shots.scene: 加号和箭头图标并列
shots.prompt_en: A plus sign icon next to an upward arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 既要指出长处，也要给改进建议。

shots.scene: 六个图标围成一圈：书、积木、字母、星星、页面、尺子
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a circle: an open book, stacked blocks, a letter tile, a star, a page layout and a ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 反馈从几个方面入手：

shots.scene: 欣欣逐个点亮这些图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot taps each icon in the circle and they light up one by one.
shots.narration: 内容、结构、语法、效果和格式。

shots.scene: 论点框下面有几根柱子撑着
shots.prompt_en: A top box held up by several pillars of evidence. No people.
shots.narration: 看内容：论点有没有展开、有支撑？

shots.scene: 几个要点框，其中一个很空
shots.prompt_en: Several topic boxes, one of them nearly empty compared with the others. No people.
shots.narration: 每个主要观点，讲得够不够？

shots.scene: 证据图标被箭头连到论点上
shots.prompt_en: Evidence document icons connected by arrows to one main claim box. No people.
shots.narration: 证据恰当吗？有说服力吗？

shots.scene: 文献图标嵌进文章段落中
shots.prompt_en: Small reference book icons woven into paragraphs of a blank page. No people.
shots.narration: 来源要融进全文，能证实文中的说法。

shots.scene: 论文第一页顶端的一句话被聚光灯照亮
shots.prompt_en: A spotlight shining on one line at the top of the first page of a blank paper. No people.
shots.narration: 看结构：论点是论文的第一印象。

shots.scene: 所有段落像珠子一样串在一根线上
shots.prompt_en: Paragraph blocks strung like beads on one thread. No people.
shots.narration: 全文围绕一个中心，前后连得上吗？

shots.scene: 一个范围过大的圈被缩小到合适大小
shots.prompt_en: A huge circle shrinking to a smaller, manageable circle that fits on a few pages. No people.
shots.narration: 题目够不够窄，篇幅内能不能讲透？

shots.scene: 第一段被高亮，旁边是路标
shots.prompt_en: The first paragraph of a blank paper is highlighted, with a road signpost beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看引言：问题提出来了吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰读完第一段，指向前方
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes reading the first paragraph and points ahead confidently.
shots.narration: 读完第一段，知道论文往哪走吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰读完全文，又翻回第一页对照
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes the whole draft and flips back to the first page to compare.
shots.narration: 读完全文回头看，引言和全文相符吗？

shots.scene: 每个段落旁边浮出一个小要点框
shots.prompt_en: Each paragraph of a blank page has a small summary box floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看正文：每段的要点是什么？

shots.scene: 证据连线同时连到段落要点和全文论点
shots.prompt_en: Evidence icons with lines linking to both a paragraph box and the main claim box. No people.
shots.narration: 证据和本段要点、全文论点连得上吗？

shots.scene: 一大段多余的引文被剪刀剪掉
shots.prompt_en: A long block of extra quoted text being trimmed away by scissors. No people.
shots.narration: 有没有多余信息，或引用太多？

shots.scene: 最后一段被高亮，旁边是终点旗
shots.prompt_en: The last paragraph of a blank paper is highlighted, with a finish flag beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看结论：是否结合讨论，重申主要论断？

shots.scene: 阿杰合上论文，头顶冒出一个灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the draft with a light bulb appearing above his head.
shots.narration: 读完后，你对最初的问题理解清楚了吗？

shots.scene: 引号图标和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A quotation mark icon beside a shield icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 看引用：正确引用，消除抄袭嫌疑。

shots.scene: 引文旁的小箭头指向一本书
shots.prompt_en: A quoted line with a small arrow pointing to the book it came from. No people.
shots.narration: 也让读者知道，信息从哪里来。

shots.scene: 段落中两种颜色：作者观点和引用观点
shots.prompt_en: A paragraph with lines in two colors, one for the author's own ideas and one for borrowed ideas. No people.
shots.narration: 哪些是作者的观点，哪些来自文献？

shots.scene: 每条引语都有引入和出处标注
shots.prompt_en: Each quote in a paragraph has a short lead-in line and a bracket citation after it. No people.
shots.narration: 每条引语，都有交代、有出处吗？

shots.scene: 正文里的标注和末尾的参考文献表连线配对
shots.prompt_en: Lines connecting citation marks in the text to matching entries in a reference list at the end. No people.
shots.narration: 看参考文献：文中引的，表里都要有。

shots.scene: 表里多出一条没有连线的条目，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: One reference entry with no matching line in the text, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 表里列的，文中也要用到，别凑数。

shots.scene: 五本书和期刊图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of five sources: two books and three journal icons. No people.
shots.narration: 格式正确，来源够数，有书也有期刊。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着一行字，错字处有红色波浪线
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a line of text with a red wavy underline under one word. No people.
shots.narration: 看语法：拼写、语法、标点对不对？

shots.scene: 用词、主谓搭配、完整句三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a word tile, two linked puzzle pieces and a complete sentence bar. No people.
shots.narration: 用词恰当，搭配一致，句子完整。

shots.scene: 一句话错了一个字，意思被扭曲的示意
shots.prompt_en: A sentence bar with one wrong tile causing an arrow to bend off in the wrong direction. No people.
shots.narration: 错误会分散注意，甚至改变原意。

shots.scene: 封面、标题、页数、行距、页边距图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cover page, a title bar, a page count, line spacing and page margins. No people.
shots.narration: 看格式：封面、标题、篇幅、行距、边距。

shots.scene: 三四页论文、双倍行距和页边距示意
shots.prompt_en: Three or four pages of a blank paper with wide double line spacing and even one-inch margins marked by small arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 3到4页，双倍行距，1英寸页边距。

shots.scene: 几页论文排版整齐统一
shots.prompt_en: Several pages of a blank paper laid out with neat, consistent formatting. No people.
shots.narration: 引用按规定格式，统一了才好读。

shots.scene: 一本书的内容旁边加了一颗星
shots.prompt_en: A page with dense content and a star added beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看效果：光有内容还不够。

shots.scene: 生动的词语卡片、清楚的句子、平滑的桥
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a colorful word card, a clear sentence bar and a smooth bridge between two paragraph blocks. No people.
shots.narration: 用词具体吗？句子清楚吗？过渡顺吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰读得入迷，忘了时间
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a draft with great interest, a clock behind him spinning fast.
shots.narration: 论文能不能抓住读者？

shots.scene: 红色加号旁边写满表扬便签
shots.prompt_en: A red plus sign with several sticky notes of praise icons around it. No people.
shots.narration: 先说写得好的地方。

shots.scene: 批注“错”被划掉，换成“可以这样改”的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A harsh red X comment is replaced by a helpful arrow pointing to a suggested improvement. No people.
shots.narration: 提建议，而不只是挑毛病。

shots.scene: 问号气泡贴在一段话旁边
shots.prompt_en: A question mark speech bubble attached beside one paragraph. No people.
shots.narration: 看不懂的地方，直接提问。

shots.scene: 阿杰认真写下详细的反馈，小研笑着接过
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes detailed feedback; the female graduate student receives it with a smile.
shots.narration: 这样的反馈，才真正帮得上忙。

shots.scene: 笔记本上荧光笔标记和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with highlighted lines and a question mark in the margin. No people.
shots.narration: 划出要点，连上旧知识，写下疑问。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研围着桌子讨论
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student discuss drafts together at a table.
shots.narration: 互评练的是批判阅读和反馈能力。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现评分表和两遍阅读图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a rubric sheet and two reading glasses.
shots.narration: 先看标准，读两遍，边读边记。

shots.scene: 内容、结构、引用、语法、格式、效果六个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Six icons with green checks in a row: a book, blocks, quotation marks, a letter tile, a page layout and a star. No people.
shots.narration: 内容结构，引用语法，格式效果。

shots.scene: 加号、箭头、问号图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a plus sign, a helpful arrow and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 说优点、提建议、多提问。

shots.scene: 书本和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open book and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 互评让你更会读，也更会写。

shots.scene: 欣欣和两份改好的论文一起挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside two neatly finished papers.
shots.narration: 互相帮助，一起进步，下次见！
